    "Replace the duplicated olive oil shelf photo in the 'Kaj najdete pri nas' product grid with a close-up of a single olive oil bottle.",
    "Increase the line-height on the oversized 'Oljka in sol' footer display text on mobile so the descender of 'j' does not collide with the ascender of 'l'.",
